General introduction
Biology is an important branch of natural science. It is the study of life. The object of study in Biology is living organisms (plants, animals, microorganisms, etc.), such as the formation, development, and evolution of species; the morphological, structural, metabolic, physiological, and genetic characteristics of organisms; and the relationships between organisms and their surrounding environment.
The field of Biology has six specialized study areas:
Animal biology
The program equips students with in-depth knowledge and skills in animal biology, including cell technology, assisted reproductive technology, biomedical materials, human genetics, and aquaculture techniques, to support their teaching, research, production, and business activities, as well as their pursuit of higher education both domestically and internationally.
Microbiology
The program equips students with knowledge and research skills in microorganisms (structure, function, growth, development, metabolism, genetic diversity of microorganisms, etc.) and the applied role of microorganisms in agriculture, industry, medicine, environment, etc.
Biochemistry
Equipping students with knowledge and skills related to food biochemistry, medical biochemistry, environmental biochemistry, and agriculture, forestry, and fisheries, such as Food Biochemistry; Medical Biochemistry; Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries Biochemistry; Environmental Biochemistry - Biofuels.
Plant Biology
The program equips students with knowledge and research skills in plant physiology, providing a foundation for controlling plant development processes, especially growth, yield, and quality, as well as plant resistance and adaptation; enabling them to effectively implement research methods on plant nutrition and development, in vitro culture techniques specifically for micropropagation, metabolic compound extraction, protoplast culture, and the extraction of genetically modified plants.
Genetics – Molecular Biology
This course equips students with fundamental knowledge in the field of Genetics and Molecular Biology on various subjects such as humans and animals, plants, and microorganisms. Students will be able to understand and apply knowledge of DNA, genes, chromosomes, genetic engineering techniques, and molecular biology techniques. Upon graduation, students will have the knowledge and skills to research disease mechanisms, develop diagnostic tools, clone genes, sequence genes, breed and select new varieties, propagate plants in vitro, analyze chromosomes, etc.

Đánh giá từ nhà tuyển dụng
Theo khảo sát của Khoa Sinh học – Công nghệ Sinh học với các nhà tuyển dụng hàng năm, trong quá trình tuyển dụng, phần lớn các nhà tuyển dụng sẽ chú trọng đến các năng lực, kỹ năng và thái độ sinh viên được rèn luyện sau 4 năm đại học. Đồng thời, phần lớn nhà tuyển tham gia khảo sát cho biết không phân biệt hoặc ít phân biệt sinh viên tốt nghiệp từ ngành Sinh học hay ngành Công nghệ Sinh học khi tuyển dụng vào các vị trí công việc tại đơn vị. Bên cạnh đó, hiện nay sinh viên ngành Sinh học có thể tham gia làm việc trong các bệnh viện và có thể học tập thêm để đạt được chứng chỉ hành nghề xét nghiệm.

General introduction
Biology is an important branch of natural science. It is the study of life. The object of study in Biology is living organisms (plants, animals, microorganisms, etc.), such as the formation, development, and evolution of species; the morphological, structural, metabolic, physiological, and genetic characteristics of organisms; and the relationships between organisms and their surrounding environment.
The field of Biology has six specialized study areas:
Animal biology
The program equips students with in-depth knowledge and skills in animal biology, including cell technology, assisted reproductive technology, biomedical materials, human genetics, and aquaculture techniques, to support their teaching, research, production, and business activities, as well as their pursuit of higher education both domestically and internationally.
Microbiology
The program equips students with knowledge and research skills in microorganisms (structure, function, growth, development, metabolism, genetic diversity of microorganisms, etc.) and the applied role of microorganisms in agriculture, industry, medicine, environment, etc.
Biochemistry
Equipping students with knowledge and skills related to food biochemistry, medical biochemistry, environmental biochemistry, and agriculture, forestry, and fisheries, such as Food Biochemistry; Medical Biochemistry; Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries Biochemistry; Environmental Biochemistry - Biofuels.
Plant Biology
The program equips students with knowledge and research skills in plant physiology, providing a foundation for controlling plant development processes, especially growth, yield, and quality, as well as plant resistance and adaptation; enabling them to effectively implement research methods on plant nutrition and development, in vitro culture techniques specifically for micropropagation, metabolic compound extraction, protoplast culture, and the extraction of genetically modified plants.
Genetics – Molecular Biology
This course equips students with fundamental knowledge in the field of Genetics and Molecular Biology on various subjects such as humans and animals, plants, and microorganisms. Students will be able to understand and apply knowledge of DNA, genes, chromosomes, genetic engineering techniques, and molecular biology techniques. Upon graduation, students will have the knowledge and skills to research disease mechanisms, develop diagnostic tools, clone genes, sequence genes, breed and select new varieties, propagate plants in vitro, analyze chromosomes, etc.

This course equips students with fundamental knowledge in the field of Genetics and Molecular Biology on various subjects such as humans and animals, plants, and microorganisms. Students will be able to understand and apply knowledge of DNA, genes, chromosomes, genetic engineering techniques, and molecular biology techniques. Upon graduation, students will have the knowledge and skills to research disease mechanisms, develop diagnostic tools, clone genes, sequence genes, breed and select new varieties, propagate plants in vitro, analyze chromosomes, etc.
